capabilities: Find notes containing a given inline tag in configured folders
Render matching files as a checkbox list in a note
Delete a note file permanently when its checkbox is clicked
Reorder checklist items with drag-and-drop and persist the order
Configure tag, folders and subfolder depth in a code block
disambiguation: Not a task manager for tasks inside notes; the checklist items are note files, and checking one deletes the file permanently.
extras: The README is written in Russian. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and warns that checking an item means irreversible deletion ("Trash — значит trash").
problem: Obsidian can find tagged notes but offers no way to triage them as a checklist and dispose of finished note files in one click.
summary: Renders a dynamic checklist of notes matching an inline tag, and permanently deletes a file when its checkbox is ticked.
